_comment: Import this file through the Pelican or Pterodactyl admin panel's Nests/Eggs import action.
name: Famstagram v1.1.7
author: admin@example.com
description: Private, invite-only family photo and video sharing app built with Next.js, Prisma, and SQLite.
startup: set -e; export APP_ROOT="${APP_ROOT:-$(pwd)}"; if ! command -v git >/dev/null; then echo 'Git is unavailable in the runtime image.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -d .git ]; then echo 'No Git checkout found. Reinstall the server once to initialize it.'; exit 1; fi; NEED_BUILD=0; echo 'Checking GitHub for updates...'; LOCAL_REVISION=$(git rev-parse HEAD); git fetch --depth=1 origin "{{GIT_BRANCH}}"; REMOTE_REVISION=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD); if [ "$LOCAL_REVISION" != "$REMOTE_REVISION" ]; then echo 'New revision found. Updating and building...'; git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; npm ci; NEED_BUILD=1; fi; if [ ! -f .next/standalone/server.js ]; then echo 'Standalone build missing; rebuilding...'; npm ci; NEED_BUILD=1; fi; if [ "$NEED_BUILD" = "1" ]; then npm run build; echo 'Applying database migrations...'; npx prisma migrate deploy; echo 'Ensuring initial admin account...'; npm run db:ensure-admin; npm cache clean --force; rm -rf node_modules .next/cache; fi; rm -rf .next/cache; echo 'Starting standalone server...'; HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} npm run start

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

export HOME=/mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  echo "Installation failed: set Git Repository (GIT_REPO) before reinstalling."
  exit 1
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
  echo "Installation failed: set Git Branch (GIT_BRANCH) before reinstalling."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Cloning branch ${GIT_BRANCH} from ${GIT_REPO}"
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates rsync

rm -rf /tmp/famstagram
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/famstagram
rsync -a --delete --exclude=uploads --exclude=dev.db /tmp/famstagram/ /mnt/server/
cd /mnt/server
npm ci
npx prisma generate
npx prisma migrate deploy
npm run build
npm run db:ensure-admin
npm cache clean --force
rm -rf node_modules .next/cache

mkdir -p "${UPLOAD_DIR}"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of the Famstagram Git repository.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone during installation.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: A unique random secret with at least 32 characters. Do not change it after users have signed in.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Keep the default to store the SQLite database at /home/container/dev.db.

variables.name: App Origin
variables.description: Canonical public URL of the app, including https://, used for server-side redirects behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: WebAuthn Origin
variables.description: Exact public origin used by passkeys, including scheme and port when applicable, for example https://photos.example.com.

variables.name: WebAuthn Relying Party ID
variables.description: Hostname used by passkeys without scheme or port, for example photos.example.com.

variables.name: WebAuthn Relying Party Name
variables.description: Friendly application name shown by the passkey provider.

variables.name: Upload Directory
variables.description: Persistent directory for locally stored uploads. Use S3 settings instead when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: Storage Driver
variables.description: Use local for files in UPLOAD_DIR, or s3 for an S3-compatible object store.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Used only when manually running npm run db:seed for the first time.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Used only when manually running npm run db:seed for the first time.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Required. Used to create the initial admin account if it does not exist. Choose a strong password.

variables.name: S3 Endpoint
variables.description: Optional endpoint for MinIO or another S3-compatible storage service.

variables.name: S3 Region
variables.description: Region for S3-compatible storage when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Bucket
variables.description: Bucket name when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Access Key
variables.description: Access key when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: VAPID Public Key
variables.description: Public key for browser push notifications. Generate it with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys

variables.name: VAPID Private Key
variables.description: Private key paired with the VAPID public key. Keep this secret.

variables.name: VAPID Contact
variables.description: Contact address required by Web Push. A plain email is accepted; the app adds mailto: automatically when needed.

variables.name: Push Debug Logging
variables.description: Set to true to log masked server-side Web Push diagnostics, including VAPID fingerprint, provider status, and rejected subscription cleanup.

variables.name: Upload Debug Logging
variables.description: Set to true temporarily to log upload MIME detection and GPS extraction diagnostics. GPS coordinates and filenames are omitted.
